boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase ways to spend time around Duluth, from a campus chapel and woodland paths to lakeside public places.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel
cards.title: Pause in Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel
cards.subtitle: St. Scholastica Duluth campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a quiet reset, then take a few minutes to look at the chapel’s stained glass and icons. The College says all are welcome.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel open to all for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Scholastica identifies Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel as a campus prayer space and states that all are welcome.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: The College describes it as a campus prayer space and says all are welcome; no admission or purchase is stated.

cards.title: Walk the Valley of Silence trails
cards.subtitle: St. Scholastica Duluth campus
cards.notes: Use the wooded campus route for a conversation walk or solo stretch, and connect onward to Chester Park trails only if conditions suit your group.
cards.short_summary: A College-documented seasonal nature walk on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Scholastica says visitors are welcome to walk trails through the Valley of Silence and connect to the Chester Park trail system.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: The College expressly welcomes walks there in every season; no admission or purchase is stated.

cards.title: Browse the Lake Superior Maritime Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Canal Park · Duluth
cards.notes: Make this a weather-proof stop to look through maritime exhibits and regroup before a Lakewalk stroll. Check the visitor center’s current opening information first.
cards.short_summary: A free maritime visitor center in Canal Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth identifies the Lake Superior Maritime Visitor Center as free.
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth calls the visitor center free; its page notes daily hours and a Wednesday closure, so confirm before going.

cards.title: Stroll the Duluth Lakewalk
cards.subtitle: Bayfront Park to Brighton Beach · Duluth
cards.notes: Choose a short out-and-back section and leave time for lake views, public art, or a park stop. Use established access points rather than shoreline shortcuts.
cards.short_summary: A paved public lakeside route for an easy walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists strolling the Lakewalk among free activities and describes it as nearly eight miles of paved path.
cards.source_title: Ten Family (and Budget!) Friendly Things to Do in Duluth This Summer and Fall
cards.access_notes: The source describes the Lakewalk as a free activity; select a public access point and check city updates for any construction impacts.

cards.title: Climb Enger Tower
cards.subtitle: Enger Park · Duluth
cards.notes: Plan a daytime viewpoint stop and pair it with a low-key walk through Enger Park. The listed season runs from May 1 until snow arrives.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal tower visit in Enger Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists climbing Enger Tower as a free activity and says it is open from May 1 until snow arrives.
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth labels this activity free and gives a seasonal operating window; use daytime and verify conditions before heading out.

cards.title: Stroll the Duluth Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Leif Erikson Park · Duluth
cards.notes: Meet by the garden, take a slow loop through the plantings, and continue onto the adjacent Lakewalk. Keep the plan flexible around seasonal bloom conditions.
cards.short_summary: A free garden walk beside Lake Superior.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth calls the Duluth Rose Garden a free option and places it within Leif Erikson Park.
cards.source_title: Ten Family (and Budget!) Friendly Things to Do in Duluth This Summer and Fall
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth explicitly describes the garden stroll as free; the City identifies it as part of Leif Erikson Park.

cards.title: Take a shoreline break at Park Point
cards.subtitle: Park Point · Duluth
cards.notes: Bring water and a layer, then use the beach for a simple lake-view hang or a short walk. Stay on established public areas and watch changing lake conditions.
cards.short_summary: A free public beach stop on Park Point.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists dipping toes in the water at Park Point among free activities in Duluth.
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth lists Park Point as a free activity location; use public beach access and exercise normal water safety.

cards.title: Watch Lake Superior at Brighton Beach
cards.subtitle: Brighton Beach · Duluth
cards.notes: Use the beach as a calm meet-up point for skipping stones, looking for ships, or starting a nearby Lakewalk segment. Keep clear of rough water and slippery rocks.
cards.short_summary: A free Lake Superior shoreline hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists dipping toes in the water at Brighton Beach among free activities in Duluth.
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth lists Brighton Beach as free; choose public shoreline space and account for surf, weather, and rock conditions.

cards.title: Meet up at Playfront Park
cards.subtitle: Bayfront Park · Duluth
cards.notes: Use Duluth’s largest playground for an active, no-cost group stop, then linger nearby for conversation. Keep the visit considerate of children and families using the area.
cards.short_summary: A free public playground at Bayfront Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists playing at Playfront Park, described there as Duluth’s largest playground, among free activities.
cards.access_notes: Visit Duluth includes Playfront Park in its free-activities list; no admission or purchase is required for the listed play activity.

cards.title: Window-shop around Canal Park
cards.subtitle: Canal Park · Duluth
cards.notes: Walk the district with a shared photo prompt or browse storefront displays without building a purchase into the plan. Treat shops as businesses first and respect posted entry rules.
cards.short_summary: A free browsing walk through Canal Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Duluth lists window shopping in Canal Park among free activities in Duluth.
cards.access_notes: The source explicitly includes Canal Park window shopping in free activities; individual businesses may set their own entry rules.
